So no, Thundermail will not replace the Thunderbird email client.

content:
Thanks to your screen shot the diagnosis should be easy. I think that you are seeing one of these bugs https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2071951 or https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2075935 or maybe both.

The only solution I know to "unblock" Thunderbird and make it reactive again is to delete the session.json file from the Thunderbird profile folder. I have described this manipulation in this message https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1613132#answer-1858261 in another thread

If this solution works for you and until the bug gets fixed, avoid to leave very many messages - in particular PDF files - still opened in tabs when you close Thunderbird.
